title: three.js cosmic horror game made with Opus 5.5
author: Zenpher
selftext:
I've been working on a cosmic horror concept game since Opus 5.5 came out. Very impressed at how quick the look and feel of the game was able to come together. I reused some terrain generation code from a parallel project I'm working on (PlayCanvas) and it worked great. Weather effects, vegetation, fog, etc.. took a lot of tweaking.

I still think Astra Ultra edges out over Opus overall but it's really cost prohibitive. At this point the $20 Claude plan is way more usable than the $100 Codex plan.
